Google Ads / PPC

Pay for attention that can become customers.

Search, Performance Max, Shopping and YouTube campaigns with conversion tracking and ongoing optimisation.

Book a Strategy Call →View Pricing →

The problem

Clicks are easy to buy and hard to turn into business. Without clear structure and conversion tracking, accounts spend on broad keywords, send traffic to pages that don't match the search, and leave you unable to tell which campaigns are worth the money.

Our solution

We structure accounts around intent, write ads that match what people are searching for, align landing pages, and set up conversion tracking so decisions rest on enquiries and sales, not clicks. Budgets are reviewed and re-allocated regularly.

Our process

  1. Goals and tracking audit

    What counts as a conversion, and whether it is measured correctly.

  2. Account and campaign structure

    Keywords, match types, negatives, audiences and budgets.

  3. Ads and landing alignment

    Ad copy, assets and landing page recommendations.

  4. Launch

    Staged launch with checks on spend and tracking.

  5. Weekly optimisation

    Search terms, bids, budgets and creative reviewed continuously.

  6. Reporting

    Plain-language reports tied to your business goals.

Deliverables

  • Account audit or new account set-up
  • Keyword research and negative keyword lists
  • Ad copy and assets
  • Conversion tracking via Google tag and GA4
  • Shopping feed support where relevant
  • Ongoing optimisation
  • Monthly reports with next actions

Ideal customer

  • Businesses with existing search demand for their services or products
  • E-commerce stores using Shopping and Performance Max
  • Lead-generation businesses that need a steady flow of enquiries

A note on results

We do not guarantee specific results. Outcomes depend on your market, offer, budget and competition. We agree measures and targets with you, report honestly and recommend what to do next.
